login.title: Sign in to Flow
login.opening_portal: Signed in as {{email}}. Opening client portal…
login.hero_body: Tasks, sprints, code, deployments, and clients — engineered into one opinionated workspace. Three sides of the same cube.
login.feature_replaces_title: Linear, Notion, Slack, GSheets — all routed through one model.

settings.title: Settings
settings.admin_only_body: Ask a workspace admin to grant you access.

profile.title: Profile
profile.hint: Read-only for now — managed via your Google Workspace account.
profile.session_rotation: Tokens are rotated every 15 minutes. Sign out from the sidebar to revoke immediately.
profile.weekly_target_hint: When set, your dashboard shows progress vs target and a consecutive-weeks streak. Leave blank to hide the streak widget.
profile.bad_range: Enter a number between 1 and 168 (or leave blank to clear).
profile.language_hint: Changes the UI immediately and is remembered on this device.
profile.preview_sentence: This is how dates look: {{date}}, currency: {{money}}

security.title: Security & Privacy
security.hint: Account access, two-factor auth, session control, and your data.
security.kind_hint: 'internal' = signs in via Google OAuth. 'client' = magic-link guest using the client portal.
security.expires_hint: The access token expiry. The refresh token in your cookie stays valid longer; we rotate the access token silently every 15 minutes.
security.mfa_hint: Adds a 6-digit code from an authenticator app on top of your password / Google login.
security.mfa_prompt_on_signin: You will be prompted for a code on each new sign-in.
security.mfa_scan_qr: Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy, or any other RFC 6238 TOTP app. Then enter the 6-digit code below.
security.mfa_cant_scan: Can't scan? Enter the secret manually:
security.mfa_enter_code_hint: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app to confirm setup.
security.mfa_enabled_blurb: MFA enabled. Save these backup codes somewhere safe — each one is single-use and lets you sign in if you lose your authenticator. They will not be shown again.
security.mfa_disable_hint: Enter a 6-digit code or a backup code to confirm.
security.sessions_hint: Each row is a separate browser or device.
security.sessions_confirm_current: This will sign you out of this browser. Continue?
security.audit_hint: The last 50 sign-ins, MFA events, and session changes on your account.
security.quick_signout_body: Revokes the current browser's access and refresh tokens.
security.quick_signout_all_body: Revokes all refresh tokens for your account, everywhere.
security.quick_signout_all_confirm: Sign out of every browser and device? Other sessions will be revoked on next request.
security.your_data_hint: Export and deletion are routed to a workspace admin for now — self-serve is on the roadmap.
security.export_body: A copy of your tasks, comments, and worklog as JSON. We'll email you when it's ready.
security.delete_body: Permanently removes your account and authored content. Cannot be undone.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: Per-event delivery channels. Defaults: in-app on, chat off until you bind Google Chat.
notifications.delivery_hint: Configure browser pushes and workspace-wide snooze.
notifications.desktop_hint: System-level toasts when the browser tab isn't focused. The in-app bell keeps counting either way.
notifications.desktop_body: Surface @mentions, blockers, and assignments as system toasts when the tab isn't focused. The in-app bell stays on regardless.
notifications.perm_denied: Permission denied. Re-enable in your browser site settings.
notifications.perm_unsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
notifications.snooze_hint: Mutes Chat + desktop pings. The in-app bell badge still counts so you can find missed items when you return.
notifications.snooze_body: Mute Chat + desktop pings (in-app stays on so the bell badge still counts) for a focus block.
notifications.dnd_hint: Recurring quiet hours. During a window, in-app + Chat notifications are dropped (the bell still counts what you missed).
notifications.dnd_empty: No quiet hours set. Add one below — e.g. weekday evenings or the whole weekend.
notifications.matrix_hint: Per-event delivery. In-app pings the bell badge; Chat needs Google Chat bound under Integrations.
notifications.matrix_event_hint: Triggers fire whenever the matching change happens to a task you're watching, an @mention of you, or a project you've subscribed to.

ai.title: AI
ai.hint: Tune duplicate detection, auto-prioritization, and the LLM provider for the whole workspace.
ai.read_only: Read-only — only workspace Admins can edit AI settings.
ai.dup_threshold_hint: Tasks whose embedding similarity is ≥ {{value}} are flagged as duplicates by the AI comment bot.
ai.priority_weights_hint: Used by the auto-prioritization processor when scoring deadline / blocker / customer-impact signals. 0 disables that factor.
ai.llm_provider_hint: `auto` defers to the API's LLM_PROVIDER env. Forcing a provider here overrides it; misconfigured providers (e.g. Anthropic without API key) silently fall back.
ai.auto_suggest_hint: Master switch for AI affordances (priority suggestion, duplicate detection comments, standup cards). Disable to make the workspace AI-quiet.
ai.preview_paused: Auto-suggest is disabled — preview is paused.
ai.preview_no_sample: Live preview unavailable — no recent open task to score against.
ai.preview_flag_count: would flag {{count}} similar open task at this threshold.
ai.preview_flag_count_plural: would flag {{count}} similar open tasks at this threshold.
